SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Section Station,
I. O. D. 522
Date September 24, 1929

Subject (in full) Miss Mary Kuksova.

Made by D.S. Ovsiannikoff. Forwarded by Jno Robertson, C.D.I.

Sir,
With reference to the attached file, inquiries go to show that Miss Mary Kuksova was engaged by a Russian family named Lugovoi as a nurse to their child, and arrived in Shanghai from Vladivostock in the summer of 1917. She worked for the family for about 2 years and then sometime in 1919, it was alleged that she was raped by Lugovoi during the absence of his wife from home. On the same day Miss M. Kuksova left Lugovoi's home and went to the Destitute Foreign Women's home where she found a temporary shelter. She lived in the Foreign Women's home for a considerable time and whilst being kept there gave birth to a girl (the illegitimate child of Lugovoi). When the girl was about 3 years old Miss Kuksova had obtained employment as a nurse with some foreign family, where she worked for a short time and changed it for a similiar position, but with better prospects. About 3 years ago Miss M. Kuksova obtained a position as a dancing partner in the International Bar, Broadway where she worked for about 2 years and then resigned and obtained a similiar position in the Minerva Cafe, Broadway. She worked in the Minerva Cafe for a short time but soon was dismissed on account of her present illness. It appears from inquiries that Miss M. Kuksova has a brother living in Vladivostock but his present address is unknown. Miss M. Kuksova has a lady friend named Shura Lavtarevskaia residing at 12 Kunming Road, who supported her during the beginning of this year and who took her to the Country Hospital. Mrs. Lavtarevskaia a dancing girl by profession stated that she has no funds and unable to give any monetary assistance to Miss Kuksova.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

档案编号。
上海公共租界工部局警务处
外侨科巡捕房，
I. O. D. 522
日期 1929年9月24日

事由（全称）玛丽·库克索娃小姐（Miss Mary Kuksova）。

呈报人：D.S. 奥夫相尼科夫（Ovsiannikoff）。转呈人：Jno Robertson，刑事侦缉处督察长（C.D.I.）。

先生：
关于所附档案，经查询显示，玛丽·库克索娃小姐受雇于一个名为卢戈沃伊（Lugovoi）的俄国家庭，担任其孩子的保姆，并于1917年夏季从符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostock）抵达上海。她为该家庭工作了约两年，随后在1919年的某个时候，据称在其妻子离家期间，她被卢戈沃伊强奸。同日，M. 库克索娃小姐离开了卢戈沃伊的家，前往贫困外籍妇女收容所（Destitute Foreign Women's home），在那里找到了临时栖身之所。她在该外籍妇女收容所居住了相当长的一段时间，在此期间生下一名女孩（卢戈沃伊的非婚生子女）。当女孩大约3岁时，库克索娃小姐在某外籍家庭找到了一份保姆工作，她工作了很短时间后，便换了一份类似但前景更好的职位。大约3年前，M. 库克索娃小姐在百老汇路国际酒吧（International Bar, Broadway）获得了一份舞伴的工作，她在那里工作了约两年，然后辞职，并在百老汇路的密涅瓦咖啡馆（Minerva Cafe, Broadway）获得了类似的职位。她在密涅瓦咖啡馆工作了很短时间，但因目前患病很快被解雇。经查询，M. 库克索娃小姐有一个兄弟住在符拉迪沃斯托克，但其目前地址不详。M. 库克索娃小姐有一位女性朋友名叫舒拉·拉夫塔列夫斯卡娅（Shura Lavtarevskaia），居住在昆明路12号，她在今年年初曾资助库克索娃小姐，并送她去了广慈医院（Country Hospital）。拉夫塔列夫斯卡娅夫人职业为舞女，她表示自己并无资金，无法向库克索娃小姐提供任何金钱援助。

Mr. Grosse, Chairman of the local Russian Charity
Committee when interviewed by me on September 23, 1929
stated that he is not in a position to furnish any means to
keep her in hospital and that he can only provide her with
a steamer ticket in case she wished to be sent away from
Shanghai. Miss Kulsove's daughter is kept at present in
the Foreign Women's home, 10 Baikal Road.

V. Orfanidinoff

POLITICAL BRANCH
(FOREIGN SECTION)
DATE 21. 9. 29.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
File No. L. 522
Date 23. 9. 29.

(C.I.D.) Office Notes

Mrs. M. Yuksova

Sir,

On the afternoon of the 20th. September, Dr.
Chambers of the Country Hospital, Great Western Road,
called at this office and requested assistance to trace
the relatives of one Mrs. M. Yuksov, Russian, who was admitted
to the above mentioned hospital on 20th. July, and who is at
present in a state of unsound mind.

The hospital authorities are anxious that this woman
would be taken off their hands as soon as possible.

Enquiries will be made to ascertain the whereabouts
of the relatives if any, and the Russian Benevolent
Societys informed of this case.

A. M. Cruickshank
D. S.

A/ D.C.I.
C. K. May
23/9.

政治部
（外侨科）
日期 1929年9月21日。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
档案编号 L. 522
日期 1929年9月23日。

（刑事侦缉处）办公笔记

M. 尤克索娃夫人（Mrs. M. Yuksova）

先生，

9月20日下午，大西路广慈医院（Country Hospital, Great Western Road）的钱伯斯医生（Dr. Chambers）来到本办公室，请求协助寻找一名俄国妇女 M. 尤克索夫夫人（Mrs. M. Yuksov）的亲属，该妇人于7月20日被送入上述医院，目前处于精神失常状态。

院方急切希望尽快将此妇人移交给他人照料。

将进行调查以查明其亲属（如有）的下落，并将此案通报俄罗斯慈善协会（Russian Benevolent Societys）。

A. M. 克鲁克香克（Cruickshank）
副巡官（D. S.）

助理刑事侦缉处督察长（A/ D.C.I.）
C. K. 梅（May）
9月23日
